item.title: [ 63] Mamdani Was Arrested Twice by Elite NYPD Unit He's Disbanding
item.description:
https://nypost.com/2026/11/20/us-news/mayor-mamdani-was-arrested-at-least-twice-by-elite-nypd-unit-hes-controversially-disbanding/

Mayor Zohran Mamdani was at least twice zip-tied and arrested by the elite NYPD tactical unit he is disbanding, old photos show.

Hizzoner announced Monday that the NYPD’s Strategic Response Group (SRG) will be folded into an existing counterterrorism command and will no longer respond to protests, sparking widespread outrage and urgent warnings from rank-and-file officers.

But Mamdani did not mention his personal brushes with the unit, with footage showing him being hauled away by SRG officers at least twice years before he landed in Gracie Mansion, Crain’s New York Business first reported.

In June 2024, ABC7 filmed Mamdani — then a New York state assemblymember who would just months later announce his run for mayor — with his hands zip-tied behind his back as he was escorted away from a protest outside of Hunter College in Manhattan.

The future mayor, who had not yet announced he was running for the city’s top office, had joined protesters rallying against the Rent Guidelines Board’s vote on increases for rent-stabilized apartments.

The cop escorting Mamdani had the SRG insignia on his shoulder and the words “NYPD Strategic Response Group” on his back, as did other officers around him, the video shows.

Years earlier, in August 2021, then-Assemblyman Mamdani posted a video on his personal X account showing himself in a mask again being zip-tied and taken away by an SRG officer during a protest in Downtown Brooklyn.

Mamdani and other demonstrators were demanding an extension of the state’s eviction moratorium. He said he and fellow Assemblymember Marcela Mitaynes were among those taken into custody.

“I was among 17 who were arrested during our protest,” Mamdani posted. “We’re out now & we’ll keep fighting for these tenant protections to be passed.”

item.description:
Elon Musk says he is ‘not MAGA’ after spending millions on Trump and his allies

https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2026-election/elon-musk-says-not-maga-spending-millions-trump-allies-rcna610129

The tech billionaire spent over $250 million to help President Donald Trump return to the White House in 2024.

Elon Musk struck a more moderate tone while discussing his political affiliation Wednesday, arguing that he does not have “blind adherence” to the policies of the Republican Party or MAGA.

The tech billionaire, who spent nearly $500 million in contributions to Republican campaigns and Trump allies ahead of the midterm elections, made the remarks while he was in China as part of President Donald Trump’s delegation at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.

“I’m not MAGA,” Musk said during an interview for the New York Times DealBook Summit. “If that means sort of blind adherence to a set of policies by the Republican Party, then I certainly don’t have that.”

Musk, who moved his companies to Texas in 2020 after clashing with Democratic leaders in California, spent at least $168 million in Texas to uplift Trump allies in the midterm elections, including Senate candidate Ken Paxton and Gov. Greg Abbott, who both lost their bids.

In the interview, Musk said that he thinks Democratic Gov.-elect Gina Hinojosa will be “quite moderate” when she takes office.

“I don’t think she’s sort of a far-left governor, and based on everything I’ve heard about her, I think things will be fine in Texas with Gina as governor,” Musk said.

He argued that he spent big on campaigns because he thinks “it’s good to have some balance of power,” adding, “as a general rule” he wouldn’t want “the presidency, Senate and House all to be of the same party.”

item.title: [110] MAGA (Measles Are Great Again) as US loses its measles-free status thanks to anti-vax conservatives
item.description:
https://apnews.com/article/measles-elimination-status-us-mexico-b6694152aca12e8cf4293d9f50090ec9

The U.S. has lost its measles-free status, international health officials said Tuesday, as the highly contagious virus once relegated to medical textbooks has spread — largely among the unvaccinated — at the highest rate in more than 30 years.

Mexico also lost its measles-elimination status, following a resurgence of the virus there that included a massive outbreak in Chihuahua state. Bolivia, too, lost its status.

The Pan American Health Organization declaration has few practical implications and is largely symbolic, but it marks a sharp turnabout in a disease largely controlled through decades of scientific advances. It also may be seen as the beginning of an era in which diseases of the past become deadly problems for the modern world.

“Measles elimination is not a trophy that is won once and placed on a shelf,” Dr. Jarbas Barbosa, PAHO’s director, said at a news conference. “It is an achievement that must be safeguarded every day by closing immunity gaps and ensuring we reach every community.”

PAHO expects the U.S., Bolivia and Mexico to submit plans “in the coming weeks” for how each country will go about trying to stop transmission for at least a year and regain measles elimination status, Dr. Daniel Salas, the organization’s executive manager for immunizations, told reporters.

Measles has been spreading throughout the Americas since 2024. The outbreaks in North America started in close-knit Mennonite communities and have since spread to areas with low vaccination rates. Last year, Canada lost its measles-free designation for the first time since 1998.

International health officials consider measles eliminated when the virus is not locally spreading among residents. The designation hinges on whether a single measles chain has spread uninterrupted for at least 12 months.

item.title: [ 98] Mandami fulfills another campaign promise by disbanding divisive NYPD unit
item.description:
https://www.nbcnewyork.com/news/local/mamdani-tisch-disband-nypd-strategic-response-group/6572816/

Mayor Zohran Mamdani and NYPD Commissioner Jessica Tisch have agreed to disband the police department's Strategic Response Group, a specialized unit critics say is too militaristic when it comes to handling mass protests, but one others argue is essential to counter-terrorism operations.

Mamdani has repeatedly said he doesn't believe terrorism duties and responses to First Amendment-related incidents should fall under one unit, and he made disbanding the unit a key pledge of his 2025 mayoral campaign. Under the plan rolled out Monday, those two priorities — counter-terror and protest-related duties — will be decoupled. Counter-terror duties move under the NYPD's Intelligence and Counterterrorism Bureau.

Starting in the new year, the city will restructure its response to protests through the creation of a civilian-led Community Dialogue and De-escalation Division (CDDD). That group, created within the Mayor's Office of Community Safety, will not have weapons or arrest powers, Mamdani said in Monday's announcement.

“New Yorkers exercising their constitutional right to protest should not be met with the same police response as a terrorism threat. We are establishing a new, civilian-led approach that prioritizes dialogue, engagement and de-escalation," Mamdani said in a statement.

The mayor said it was part of "building a new approach to public safety."

To support that civilian-led group, the NYPD is creating a First Amendment Support Team (FAST) made of 30 officers trained in communication and de-escalation. FAST will lead those efforts until the new civlian-led team is established.

>how to get started
Purchase a corn cob pipe (or a cheap briar pipe) and a pouch of Half and Half or Captain Black tobacco from a smoke shop
or online. You will need a lighter or match, and something to tamp it with--a large nail works well if you don't have a pipe tool.
Fill the pipe with tobacco, pack it down halfway, top it off, pack it down to 3/4, top it off again, pack gently and enjoy. Smoke
slower than you think you need to, the tobacco tastes best when it is burning cool. Tamp and re-light as needed. If you still
have trouble, try different methods on YouTube until you find one that works for you.
>smoking a pipe will give you cancer
Originally the Surgeon General found that pipe and cigar smokers, following a careful study of the statistics (at a time when
most adults smoked, so they had a good sample size), had insignificant death rate increases. Nowadays, tobacco is being
legislated against while hard drugs are being legalized. Put two and two together. Tobacco is just another good thing under attack by the government.

>muh weed
Not the time or place. Start your own thread.

All tobacco users welcome.

item.title: [141] /twg/ - Taiwan General
item.description:
Quick Start Guide for First Timers:

Visa: Most countries get 90 days visa-free. Check if you need an eVisa or ARC if staying longer. Fill out your arrival card online before arriving for less stress.
Best Time: Oct–Dec for perfect weather (dry season). Avoid July–Sept typhoon season unless you like rain and chaos.
Getting Around: Taipei MRT is clean, cheap, and efficient as fuck. Youbike only needs an easy card and is essentially free unless you want to ride for hours.
High Speed Rail (HSR) for city hopping (Taipei Kaohsiung in ~1.5h).
Scooters are god outside Taipei. Get an international permit if you plan to ride.
Uber works but taxis are cheap. Avoid during rush hour or rain.

Food:

Night markets are mandatory. Shilin, Raohe, Ningxia, etc.
Must eats: Beef noodle soup, stinky tofu (acquired taste), oyster omelettes, bubble tea (original homeland), pineapple cake, mango shaved ice. All you can eat hotpot also.
7-11 and FamilyMart are better than in most countries, you can live off them if you want.

Top Spots:

Taipei: 101, Jiufen old street, Beitou hot springs, temples everywhere.
Taroko Gorge (east coast) — absolute kino nature.
Sun Moon Lake, Kenting (beaches), Alishan for mountains.
East coast for chill vibes and fewer tourists.

General Tips:

Taiwanese people are polite and helpful. Learn basic Mandarin or use Google Translate.
Tipping is not expected.

Useful Links & Services:

Official Taiwan Tourism: https://eng.taiwan.net.tw/
YouBike: https://en.youbike.com.tw/
EasyCard: Buy at MRT/7-11 — https://www.easycard.com.tw/en/
HSR: https://www.thsrc.com.tw/
Hot Springs: https://taiwanhotspring.net/ + https://eng.taiwan.net.tw/m1.aspx?sNo=0002035

item.title: [217] Real Traveler's map™ thread
item.description:
Post your travel maps in this thread. Pic related is the official /trv/ Real Traveler's map™, edition 4.0.5. I am remaking this general after almost a year of it being dead, so this is not the usual OP.

Fill in the countries and subdivisions you have visited, talk about your map and ask others about their maps. You can use the map however you like, the colors are more like suggestions, you don't have to use them, and you don't have to use all of them. You can add or remove colors and change the map as much as you want in any way you want. Don't like this map? Upload a completely different one. Up to you. Despite what some might say, there's no "wrong" way to use the map, and new posters and less travelled people are welcome and encouraged to stay and post :) This map is a group effort by our board, and we can only improve it if people reach out to share suggestions or corrections.

This is the newest edition of the map, edition 4.0.5, updated for September 2025. Thanks to an Anon in previous threads, it is now easier than ever to fill in the map. You can use the website splored.com to easily color in entire countries with a single click. At the time of making this thread, it uses the old 4.0.4 template, so you still need to update it to 4.0.5 with the simplified template, but hopefully it will be updated.
